questions.enonce_markdown: (a) the values of the constants $a$ and $n$.
questions.corrige_markdown:
**Value of $a$.** The probabilities of a distribution sum to 1:

$$0.1 + a + 0.4 + 0.2 = 1 \;\Longrightarrow\; a = 1 - 0.7 = 0.3$$

**Value of $n$.** Use $E(X) = \sum x\,P(X = x) = 3.5$:

$$1(0.1) + 2(0.3) + 4(0.4) + n(0.2) = 3.5$$

$$0.1 + 0.6 + 1.6 + 0.2n = 3.5 \;\Longrightarrow\; 0.2n = 3.5 - 2.3 = 1.2 \;\Longrightarrow\; n = 6$$

**$a = 0.3$ and $n = 6$.**

For constants $a, b$: $E(aX + b) = aE(X) + b$ and $\text{Var}(aX + b) = a^2\,\text{Var}(X)$ (adding a constant does not change the spread).

$$E(Y) = 4E(X) + 3 = 4(3.5) + 3 = 17$$

$$\text{Var}(Y) = 4^2\,\text{Var}(X) = 16 \times 2.65 = 42.4$$

**$E(Y) = 17$ and $\text{Var}(Y) = 42.4$.**
